en-us.exp_event_erav_politician_night1_ongoing: On the first night, $names$ keeps the councillor company in the ryokan villa's bedroom.
en-us.exp_event_erav_politician_night1_result: The councillor summons $names$ into the villa's bedroom.
en-us.event_erav_politician_night1_01:
After dinner is cleared away, the councillor has $party.name$ stand under the lamp and undoes her yukata's sash himself, slowly, pausing halfway to take in the view before continuing.
"A councillor's work is seven parts socializing. The secret of socializing is to always keep something soothing at your side."
The folding fan taps his own knee. "Sharing a bed - literally."
en-us.event_erav_politician_night1_02: The yukata slips from her shoulders. Caught in the lamplight, with nowhere to hide, she can only let that gaze measure her at its leisure.
en-us.event_erav_politician_night1_03: Between the sheets he presses down on her, unhurried, in a position that looks down on her like an elder, taking his time deep into the night.
en-us.event_erav_politician_night1_04:
Deep in the night, she is shaken out of her shallow sleep.
"A secretary reads the room. I'm not fully awake yet - by now you should know what to do."
She pushes herself up and climbs on top of him.
en-us.event_erav_politician_night1_05: Before dawn, the room holds nothing but her suppressed, shallow gasps.
en-us.event_erav_politician_night1_06:
Before daybreak he spends himself inside her, tells her to keep the position and not move, and goes back to sleep.
She lies there until morning, too afraid to stir, the heat pooled deep in her belly.
